description: This is a Java test source file for parameterized tests within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project. It defines an abstract base class for testing command adaptation, including multiple test methods and utility functions for handling JSON pointers and objects.

classes.name: ParametrizedCommandAdapterTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for parameterized command adapter testing within the Eclipse Ditto project, providing test methods and JSON utility functions.

classes.name: ParametrizedCommandAdapterTest.TestParameter
classes.description: A helper class representing a test parameter, including name, adaptable object, and command instance.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Test method to verify conversion from adaptable to command.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Test method to verify conversion from command to adaptable.

methods.name: adaptableToCommandToAdaptable
methods.description: Test method to verify round-trip conversion from adaptable to command and back.

methods.name: commandToAdaptableToCommand
methods.description: Test method to verify round-trip conversion from command to adaptable and back.

methods.name: toObjects
methods.description: Static utility to convert test parameters to a collection of object arrays for parameterized testing.

methods.name: newPointer
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPointer from string segments.

methods.name: fromIterable
methods.description: Converts an iterable source into a JsonValue object with specified key and value functions.

methods.name: entriesPath
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer to the 'entries' path.

methods.name: entriesPath(Label)
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer to the 'entries/{label}' path.

methods.name: resourcesPath(Label)
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer to the 'entries/{label}/resources' path.

methods.name: resourcesPath(Label, ResourceKey)
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer to the specific resource path within entries and label.

methods.name: subjectsPath(Label)
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer to the 'entries/{label}/subjects' path.

methods.name: subjectsPath(Label, SubjectId)
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer to a specific subject path within entries and label.
